description: The rankings of a game for one (neblla.scores; boards declared with neblla_update_app({ scores })). action "top": the best of a board, { board, period: "all" (default) | "day" (today, UTC), limit (≤ 100) } → [{ place, player, value, at, info }]; action "player": one user's standing { board, player } → { best, bestAt, dayBest, runs, place } or null; on an ELO board ({ type: "elo", start: 1200, k: 32 }, moved by the results of matches, neblla_matches) it gives { rating, played, won, drawn, lost, place, history }. Changes nothing; neblla_scores removes a score and sets a rating.
name: neblla_scores_read
title: Scores (read)
